errors.PORT_CONFLICT: The selected host port is in use. Another port will be selected before retrying.
errors.DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE: Docker Engine is unavailable. Start Docker and redeploy.
errors.IMAGE_PULL_FAILED: The Agent image could not be downloaded. Check the image name, network, and registry access.
errors.NETWORK_CREATE_FAILED: The isolated Docker network for this instance could not be created.
errors.CONTAINER_CREATE_FAILED: The instance container could not be created. Review the deployment log for the underlying cause and retry.
errors.CONTAINER_START_FAILED: The instance container was created but could not be started.
errors.HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED: The instance container started but did not pass its readiness checks.
errors.DEPLOYMENT_TIMEOUT: Deployment exceeded its deadline and was cancelled.
errors.DEPLOYMENT_RETRY_EXHAUSTED: Deployment reached the maximum number of automatic retries.
errors.CONTAINER_MISSING: The instance exists in the database, but its Docker container is missing.
errors.CLEANUP_FAILED: Some instance resources could not be cleaned up.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The instance quota has been reached.
errors.PATH_CONFLICT: Another instance already uses this access path.
errors.PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: The selected model provider is not supported by the current Agent runtime. Choose another provider or review the runtime mapping.

review.zeroTargetsDescription: The channel can connect, but no users or groups are allowed, so the bot will remain silent. Add allowlist entries, or enable Allow All only after accepting the risk.

review.completeConfigurationDescription: Complete the relevant settings in instance details.
review.recommendedActionsDescription: The instance is starting in the background. Use the action cards below to finish the required setup.
genericGuideSteps: Open instance details and confirm its status and URL.
Check model credentials and complete the model connection test.
If a messaging channel is configured, verify its permissions and allowlist.
Send the first test message and use live logs to confirm that the task completes.
